name: Website Security & SSL Scanner | Ranime Jemal Agency

parameters.content:
## Website Security & SSL Scanner
Every Monday checks each website: HTTPS, HTTP to HTTPS redirect, security headers (HSTS, CSP, clickjacking, nosniff, referrer and permissions policies), version leaks, cookie flags and certificate expiry. Each site gets a grade (A to F) with the exact fixes, logged and emailed. The **Scan a website** form runs the same check on demand and emails the report to whoever asked.
Passive checks only: it reads public responses like a browser does and never attacks the site.
1. Fill in **Settings**. 2. Make a sheet with a **Scans** tab (`scans-sheet.csv`). 3. Connect Google Sheets and Gmail. 4. Activate.

parameters.formDescription: We check HTTPS, security headers, cookies and the certificate, and email you a graded report with fixes.
